rules.blocking_scope: strong completion, health, and remediation claims
rules.override_authority: none; missing evidence must be reported UNVERIFIED
rules.recovery_action: collect fresh primary evidence and revalidate

rules.exact_verifier: repository production-path scan plus focused tests proving no CSV, Excel, SQLite, or Streamlit runtime source/fallback
rules.blocking_scope: production data ingestion, models, dashboard truth, and reporting
rules.override_authority: Avi only for documented read-only legacy recovery; never for production truth
rules.recovery_action: remove the forbidden path or isolate it as historical-only, then rerun scan and tests

rules.exact_verifier: read back canonical worktree root, HEAD, origin, cleanliness, deployed hashes, and applicable systemd WorkingDirectory/ExecStart/EnvironmentFiles
rules.blocking_scope: code edit, test attribution, deployment, and runtime claims
rules.override_authority: Avi for a separately identified deployment scope only
rules.recovery_action: stop mutation, identify the authoritative tree/version, and reconcile hashes before resuming

rules.exact_verifier: independent Turso snapshot audit of identity, immutable checksum, lifecycle events, provider lineage, counts, and downstream outputs
rules.blocking_scope: snapshot validation/promotion, model inputs, and downstream recommendations
rules.override_authority: none for immutability or lineage; Avi may approve a new replacement snapshot
rules.recovery_action: reject or quarantine the snapshot, preserve evidence, and create an idempotent replacement

rules.exact_verifier: fresh systemd readback of unit state, InvocationID, PID, command, timestamps, durable checkpoint, and representative firing where applicable
rules.blocking_scope: RUNNING, ACTIVE, healthy scheduler, and completion claims
rules.recovery_action: classify STALLED/NOT RUNNING, preserve logs, diagnose, and perform only bounded in-scope repair

rules.exact_verifier: model readiness audit over immutable lineage, spec equivalence, leakage controls, walk-forward results, diagnostics, calibration, costs, drawdown, and baseline comparison
rules.blocking_scope: model promotion, production eligibility, ETF priors, and orders
rules.override_authority: Avi may approve further research, never waive failed promotion evidence
rules.recovery_action: retain research output, mark ineligible, repair the failed control, and rerun untouched validation

rules.exact_verifier: read back operating mode, explicit approval record, kill switch, service states, plan uniqueness, risk gates, and ledger reconciliation
rules.blocking_scope: recommendation-to-order transition, sniper activation, and any external order
rules.override_authority: Avi through an explicit scoped mode transition; hard safety gates remain non-waivable
rules.recovery_action: fail closed, stop new execution, preserve plan/evidence, and reconcile before reconsideration

rules.exact_verifier: verify tested clean diff, staged secret scan, pushed commit readback, and recovery checkpoint readback
rules.blocking_scope: recovery checkpoint and claims that work is safely backed up
rules.override_authority: none for secret scan; no-change checkpoint is allowed without a commit
rules.recovery_action: remove secrets or unverified changes, retest, rescan, then create and read back the checkpoint
